owner_request: I like and want all three. Can we add a larger bus, and a truck you might see in the docks or workshop area.
creator: Vehicle workstream lead (Codex), expanded owner brief by Regner
reference_role: Existing city mood and approved car family; original larger vehicle concepts.

choices.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original vehicle concept sheet for a smooth stylized 3D irreverent top-down cyberpunk city game. Dark petrol/cyan city ambience, ordinary everyday vehicle design with restrained vivid coral/amber accents, chunky readable shapes, broad clean bevels. Entirely original and unbranded.
Composition: landscape sheet with TWO views of EXACTLY THE SAME vehicle, left an attractive complete front-left three-quarter view, right a STRICT VERTICAL TOP-DOWN overhead roof view with FRONT at TOP, no camera tilt in the overhead view. Both views must show the whole vehicle without clipping, on a quiet dark blue-grey matte studio background. At bottom include a small ivory silhouette study of that vehicle. No text anywhere. Large simplified forms, avoid fine technical detail, stylized manufactured smooth surfaces, not a photorealistic real-world brand.
Readability: designed to be seen from a straight-down perspective game camera, 47 m street height, vertical FOV 42 degrees, 1280x800. The large views are concept illustrations, not claimed game captures. Deliberately show the roof/bed arrangement and a clearly distinguishable FRONT versus REAR. Shadows and restrained small emissive headlights, no heavy bloom.
Constraints: no logos, real manufacturers, license plate text, destination text, decals, company names, people, surrounding buildings, flying parts, hover wheels, weapons, spoilers, grunge/noisy textures or micro-greebles. Keep wheel count, body shape, paint and roof features consistent between both views.
Direction D: TANDEM city bus. A larger conventional SINGLE-DECK rigid urban passenger bus, non-articulated, two axles, nominally 10.8 m long, 2.50 m wide body and 3.15 m tall (provisional visual proportions). Long chunky softly rounded rectangular body, broad warm ivory roof, dark petrol lower panels and one broad coral body band, very large dark smoked front windshield and a calm repeated row of dark side windows. Two passenger door sets on the RIGHT curb side. Broad blunt front with small warm ivory headlight blocks, flatter rear with paired modest red lights. A single low wide roof ventilation enclosure over the rear half, and one simple inset emergency hatch forward; keep most of roof a broad uninterrupted ivory color block. Practical city transit, ordinary friendly workhorse, not a luxury coach, school bus, double-decker or futuristic shuttle. Exactly two axle positions: two front tires and dual rear tires (six physical tires, four visible outer wheel positions). Distinguish cab/front overhead using dark windshield strip and the asymmetrically placed rear roof vent. Fit the entire bus in each panel; maintain long bus proportions, not a van.

Direction E: KEEL dock/workshop truck. A medium rigid cab-over dropside flatbed cargo truck that serves harbor loading yards and neighborhood workshops, nominally 6.60 m long, 2.40 m wide body and 2.90 m cab height (provisional visual proportions). Chunky short square cab with broad amber-orange roof and dark petrol front windshield, practical broad rubber bumper. Long EMPTY open rectangular load bed behind cab, low dark petrol steel drop-side panels and an ivory-grey deck. Clearly show the open cargo deck from above rather than an enclosed box roof; cabin and open bed have very different broad shapes/color values. Small squared headlamp blocks, simple plain wheel hubs, no chrome. Cab is about one third of total length, bed about two thirds. Exactly two axle positions, front near cab and rear toward the back of the cargo bed: two front tires and dual rear tires (six physical tires, four outer wheel positions visible). No crane, forklift, trailer, container, cargo, racks, tool props or engine detail. Broad simple bed panels with minimal seams. Solid plausible city commercial truck with light rounded bevels, no named industrial brand or real-world model resemblance.
